title: Cohomological descent for the comparison of the fppf topology with the small etale topos
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma is the fppf analogue of the cohomological descent statement, for bounded below complexes on the small etale topos (statement lines 21820-21828). The proof (proof lines 21830-21856) follows the pattern of the h and ph cases: reduction to a single sheaf by Leray's acyclicity lemma, rewriting of the composite pushforward through the fppf description of the pullback, and degeneration of the relative Leray spectral sequence using the fppf V-C statement and the etale cohomological descent. H2: one reduction plus one spectral sequence degeneration, written out.
